instruments.name: Square Lead
instruments.description: A hollow, woody square wave with a firm sustain for melodies that need to sit forward.

instruments.name: Octave Pulse Lead
instruments.description: A 12.5% pulse lead doubled by a quiet triangle an octave below for extra weight.

instruments.name: Acid Bass
instruments.description: A squelchy, resonant sawtooth with a snapping filter and glide, in the spirit of the TB-303.

instruments.name: Reese Bass
instruments.description: Two darkened sawtooths a hair out of tune, so long notes churn with a slow, growling beat.

instruments.name: The Chorus
instruments.description: A mellow FM body plus a quiet, high-ratio tine layer that pings on each strike, DX-style.

instruments.name: Chip Kit
instruments.description: A whole chiptune drum machine in one instrument: kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, crash, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes, with the closed hat choking the open one.
